description:
Presents is an innovative app that helps you keep your wishes organized, and instantly share them with all your friends.
After you have registered with email and password, you can start creating your wishlist by adding your wishes, specifying a title, a price and eventually a link, and you can easily sort them by priority.
Then, if you want to make a gift to a friend you just have to search their name or username in the search tab and see what they desire the most.
And that's it! With Presents you can now make a surprise to your friends gifting them exactly what they want.
